other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: For commands that stay unchanged (workflow, brainstorm) or are pre-P1/P2, the existing report does carry its own status (workflow's contract has a status field), yet this rule ignores it, so a stopped or failed workflow or brainstorm run that wrote a non-empty file is reported to Orca as succeeded.
